title: GDELT LNG share -> CF log return
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] GDELT lng GKG share 10d z-score > 1.2 leads CF log returns by 1 day (+) since LNG scarcity forces European ammonia curtailment; trade long CF 4d [gdelt.gkg.lng_share -> finance.CF.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.lng_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long CF next session

trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
